notes: Qty 61 as published: the CHARACTERS (20) section lists 21. The author notes 'One card over, my apologies. Remove Evax or a sense/alter to get the deck down to 60 cards'; dested as posted.

Posted 'DII Throne Room' dested Death Star II: Throne Room; 'DII Docking Bay' Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'Prepared Defences' Prepared Defenses; 'Mobilisation Points' Mobilization Points; 'DV,DLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Search & Destroy' Search And Destroy.

The weekend also held the Belgian Grand Slam ([[2000 Brussels Grand Slam]]); filed under the 2000 European Championship, whose hub already lists Tennet's Trandosite copy of this deck as [[Alex Tennet The Emperor's Hand]] (dest_title adds the event prefix to avoid the clash and cleans the published 'The Emperor s Hand').
dest_title: 2000 European Championship Alex Tennet The Emperor's Hand
player_note: The strategy says: 'I played this deck at the European Championship weekend in Brussells.' It records 'One timed loss to Bastian' and 'a full loss when I drew up against him the next day'; the description says 'Victorious in almost every game in both the tough European Championships and the 80-player Belgian Grand Slam. Only the machine himself, Bastian Winkelhaus, held firm against it.' (Posted 15 August 2000; no placing given.)
